import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,5); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.plot([0,10],[4,4], lw=3)
ax.text(5,4.3,'deck top unchanged')
for x in [4,6]:
    ax.plot([x,x],[4,3.2], lw=2)
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x-0.6,2.2),1.2,0.6))
    ax.plot([x-0.4,x-0.4],[2.8,3.9], lw=1); ax.plot([x+0.4,x+0.4],[2.8,3.9], lw=1)
    # zigzag spring
    ax.plot([x-0.4,x-0.4],[2.8,3.9])
    ax.text(x,2.5,'250kg TMD', ha='center', fontsize=8)
    ax.text(x,1.7,'spring+damper', ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax.annotate('midspan antinode', xy=(5,4), xytext=(5,1.0), ha='center', arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax.set_title('Twin under-deck TMDs - 40m footbridge')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
